    Products and transports of filtered lifts (toward Corollary 12.1) #

    Filtered lifts in the sense of Proposition 6.5 (FLift) are stable under finite products with shifted gradings (FLift.pi), and a B-stable subspace which is the image of an injective filtered map with injective Λ-linear leading term carries a transported filtered lift (FLift.transport): the leading-term arguments of deformation-refinements.tex.
